title: 第17章 选择第18章 灵气
content_zh:
黄老财光膀子趴在床上，背上好几道纵横交错的刀口子，血肉外翻了，看起来就很恐怖。
当时黑影每次追上来，都会劈上一两刀。
此刻黄老财面色苍白，他的媳妇，小妾，儿子，女儿，一大家子人都守在床前哭哭啼啼。
“老子！还没死……唉呦喂……”
“老爷！”
“老爷你挺住，大夫很快就来了！”
黄老财转头看向二狗子。
二狗子奔跑了一夜，现在已经累虚脱了，靠在门上休养。
当时背上有人挡着，除了背上被滋的一泡黄尿，倒是毫发无损。
他此刻心里在担忧，黄老财会不会反悔，毕竟那可是三亩地，价值60两银子。
而且黄老财现在半死不活，救人任务顶多只算完成了一半。
还有，万一黄老财没来得及交代土地的事，就一命呜呼怎么办？
二狗心中忐忑，患得患失。
“二狗，你救了我一命，石窝子里那三亩地以后就是你的了。”
终于等到黄老财的答复，二狗子高兴得从地上站了起来。
“多谢！多谢东家！”
从今以后，他不再是佃户，也是有一块土地的人了。
自己的地，他想怎么折腾就怎么折腾，不用交租，不用担心被人收回，他还可以在自己的地里盖一座瓦房子。
“唉呦喂……”
也不知道黄老财此刻是身上痛还是心痛，哼哼唧唧了好一会。

“你救我一命，这三亩地也算不得什么！”
“我还可以另送你一件大礼。”
黄老财说着，看向了身边的几个儿女，最后目光在二闺女身上定住。
“我可以给你两个选择，你可以选其中一项。”
“一是把二闺女嫁给你，陪嫁20亩良田。”
“爹……”
二闺女听到她爹这个安排，羞红了脸，低着头悄悄打量二狗子。
二狗子闻言，也有点手足无措，红着脸，低着头，偷偷打量二闺女。
两人的目光在空中碰撞到一起，又连忙缩了回去。
二狗子心突突直跳，昨天还觉得高不可攀的村花，今天就要许配给自己了，还带20亩良田的嫁妆。
也不知道第二项好处又会是什么，能跟这第一项相提并论吗?
content_en:
Huang Laocai was lying on the bed, shirtless, with several criss-crossing cuts on his back. The flesh and blood were turned out, making him look very scary.
At that time, every time the black shadow caught up with him, he would hit him with one or two knives.
At this moment, Huang Laocai's face was pale, and his wife, concubine, son, daughter, and the whole family were standing in front of the bed crying.
"I! I'm not dead yet... Oh, hey..."
"Master!"
"Master, hold on, the doctor will be here soon!"
Huang Laocai turned to look at Er Gouzi.
Ergouzi ran all night and was now exhausted and resting against the door.
There was someone blocking my back at that time, but except for a puddle of yellow urine on my back, I was unscathed.
He was worried at this moment whether Huang Laocai would regret it. After all, it was three acres of land worth 60 taels of silver.
Moreover, Huang Laocai is now half-dead, and the rescue mission is only half completed at best.
Also, what if Huang Laocai dies before he has time to explain the land?
The two dogs were anxious and worried about gains and losses.
"Er Gou, you saved my life. The three acres of land in Shiwozi will be yours from now on."
Finally waiting for Huang Laocai's reply, Er Gouzi stood up from the ground with joy.
"Thank you! Thank you boss!"
From now on, he is no longer a tenant, but also a landowner.
He can do whatever he wants with his own land. He doesn't have to pay rent or worry about being repossessed. He can also build a tiled house on his own land.
"Hey, hey..."
He didn't know whether Huang Laocai was in pain in his body or in his heart at the moment, so he groaned for a long time.
"If you save my life, these three acres of land are nothing!"
"I can also give you another big gift."
Huang Laocai said, looking at the children around him, and finally fixed his eyes on the second daughter.
"I can give you two options, you can choose one of them."
"First, I will marry my second daughter to you, along with 20 acres of fertile land."
"Dad..."
When the second daughter heard her father's arrangement, she blushed with embarrassment and lowered her head to look at Er Gouzi quietly.
When Er Gouzi heard this, he was a little at a loss. He blushed, lowered his head, and secretly looked at the second daughter.
The two people's eyes collided in the air and quickly retracted.
Ergouzi's heart was beating fast. Yesterday, the village beauty who he thought was unattainable was going to be betrothed to him today, with a dowry of 20 acres of fertile land.
I don’t know what the second benefit will be. Can it be compared with the first one?
